origin.description: Combine character vectors element by element, then optionally collapse the rows into one string.

arguments.text: Character vectors. NULL arguments are removed. A length-1 vector is recycled to the common length.

arguments.name: sep
arguments.text: A single string inserted between the vectors.

arguments.name: collapse
arguments.text: A single string used to join the rows, or NULL to keep one string per row.

origin.details: A missing element makes that row missing. Length 1 recycles, including down to length 0. Any other length mismatch is an error. An empty call, or a call whose only arguments are NULL, returns character(0).
origin.value: A character vector as long as the longest input, or one string when collapse is set.
origin.example:
joined <- str_c("Letter", letters[1:3], sep = ": ")
missing <- str_c(c("a", NA, "b"), "-d")
cat(paste0("str_c(\"Letter\", letters[1:3], sep = \": \") returns ", paste(joined, collapse = ", "), ".\n"))
cat(paste0("str_c(c(\"a\", NA, \"b\"), \"-d\") returns ", paste(ifelse(is.na(missing), "NA", missing), collapse = ", "), ".\n"))

translation.description: Drop None pieces, check the rest with size_common, then call stringi.stri_c.

arguments.name: *args
arguments.text: Strings or lists of strings. None is R's NULL and is dropped.

arguments.name: sep
arguments.text: One string inserted between the pieces. The default is empty.

arguments.name: collapse
arguments.text: None keeps one result per row. A string joins those rows.

translation.details: size_common is the vctrs size rule: length 1 recycles, and any other mismatch raises. A missing element stays missing rather than becoming the letters NA. The result is a list.
translation.value: A list of strings, or one string in a list when collapse is set.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringr.join import str_c
joined = str_c("Letter", ["a", "b", "c"], sep=": ")
missing = str_c(["a", NA, "b"], "-d")
print("str_c(\"Letter\", letters[1:3], sep = \": \") returns " + ", ".join(joined) + ".")
print("str_c(c(\"a\", NA, \"b\"), \"-d\") returns " + ", ".join("NA" if item is NA else item for item in missing) + ".")
